title: TDMA tx-gate latch globals shared across contexts; churn silently disables collision gating
description: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/lichen_link_tx.c:54-81. tdma/tdma_epoch_seen/tdma_init_done function-local statics keyed solely on epoch equality: alternating contexts with differing epochs re-run lichen_tdma_init every call resetting synced=false/ccp UNJOINED while tdma_tx_allowed returns TRUE when !synced => gate bypassed under multi-context use; statics unlocked; SECURITY-marked sync-persistence comment factually wrong (no accessor exists). Fix direction: move TDMA state into struct lichen_link_ctx per-context, correct comment, preserve load_key-before-init ordering invariant.
close_reason: TDMA latch moved into struct lichen_link_ctx (link_ctx.h CONFIG_LICHEN_TDMA-guarded fields tdma/tdma_epoch_seen/tdma_init_done, conditional include placed below length macros for include-order coherence); lichen_link_tx.c migrated off function-local statics; explicit latch reset in lichen_link_init() and lichen_link_cleanup() covering stack-allocated contexts and post-cleanup epoch-collision window; load_key-before-tdma_init ordering preserved via lazy init behind has_key; false persistence comment replaced; runtime harness (HEAD vs fix) proves multi-context gate bypass eliminated and ALL PASS with ASan/UBSan
